subject: ChatGPT Wallet 💸, Kalshi in talks to raise at $65B valuation 💰, Google Wallet in Gemini 💳

stories.headline: Kalshi in talks to raise funds at a $65 billion valuation for a compute futures platform
stories.quote: KALSHI IN TALKS TO RAISE FUNDS AT $65 BILLION VALUATION FOR COMPUTE FUTURES PLATFORM, SOURCE SAYS
stories.description: Event contracts platform planning compute-cost futures for GPU and cloud capacity

facts.text: Reuters reported Kalshi is discussing fresh funding for a platform to hedge GPU or cloud compute costs.
facts.quote: Reuters reported on November 12 that Kalshi is discussing fresh funding for a platform where companies could hedge against changes in the cost of renting GPU or cloud computing capacity.

stories.headline: Anthropic product launches described as coming ahead of its IPO
stories.quote: ANTHROPIC LAUNCHES MEETINGS, WHITEBOARDS, SHEETS, DATA AHEAD OF IPO
stories.description: Maker of the Claude AI assistant

stories.headline: Anthropic launches Claude features for meetings, whiteboards, sheets and data
stories.quote: Claude can now join video calls, answer questions in the meeting chat using information from connected apps, and turn planning discussions into timelines with assigned responsibilities.
stories.description: Maker of the Claude AI assistant

stories.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for agentic payments, initially for US ChatGPT Pro users
stories.quote: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Wallet, initially for US ChatGPT Pro users through Dots, letting agents complete purchases without seeing users' actual card details while requiring biometric approval for each transaction.

facts.text: The wallet was built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa and uses payment tokens.
facts.quote: Built with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the wallet uses payment tokens that preserve existing card rewards and dispute protections.

stories.quote: with Stripe's Bridge and Privy acquisitions providing stablecoin and wallet infrastructure around the chain.

stories.headline: Western Union terminates its $500 million deal for Intermex over California DFPI conditions
stories.quote: Western Union has terminated its $500 million deal for Intermex, saying conditions set by California's DFPI were unacceptable.

stories.headline: Google rolls out Google Wallet integration to Gemini users in the US
stories.quote: Google is rolling out Google Wallet integration to Gemini users in the US, letting the assistant analyze spending, find recurring subscriptions, and help build personalized budgets using transaction data.

stories.headline: PayPal seeks an industrial bank charter to expand merchant lending and diversify funding
stories.quote: PayPal says an industrial bank charter would support more lending to its merchant base while giving the company a cheaper and more diversified source of capital, including potential deposits.

stories.headline: Jane Street more than doubled its Nvidia stake to 23.8 million shares in Q3 filing
stories.quote: Jane Street disclosed 23.8 million Nvidia shares worth about $5.4 billion as of September 30, more than double its 11.8 million-share position in Q2, making Nvidia its second-largest reported holding.

stories.headline: Barclays reportedly plans to cut about 200 investment banking jobs in New York and London
stories.quote: Barclays is reportedly preparing to eliminate about 200 investment banking roles across seniority levels in New York and London as part of its annual performance and efficiency review.

stories.headline: North Korean operation FaceStealer reportedly stole more than $400 million in crypto using AI impersonations
stories.quote: An FBI-uncovered North Korean operation called FaceStealer stole more than $400 million in crypto over about 18 months using AI-generated impersonations of colleagues on video calls.

facts.text: The issue notes the FBI figures are secondhand, via press reports.
facts.quote: The FBI figures arrive secondhand, via press reports, and the bank scenarios are Skinner's sketch rather than documented cases.
